fieldValues.title: A domain with no axes of its own reads the base axes as working defaults
fieldValues.move: A domain with no affirmed axes of its own, and no ancestor that has them, reads the base axes (Action, Change, Perspective) and shows them as working defaults. Nobody confirms them. A domain's own affirmed axis still replaces the default on its line, and `clerk check` stops warning that such a domain lacks axes.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: Who merges a group's PRs: whether a default axis counts toward a mature domain under decision 3b910d90 is a separate question. Offering a parent's personas to a subdomain (remedy f86a827a).
fieldValues.falsifier: Decisions in a domain cannot honestly be placed on the base axes, or the owner keeps replacing the defaults because they mislead there.
fieldValues.return_when: A domain's work is judged wrongly because its default axes did not fit it.
